one_liner: Plaid has a broad REST API with free Sandbox for everyone; the free Production Trial is limited to US/CA signups, and full production needs approval.
auth_notes: Core API uses client_id and secret sent with each request, plus per-user access_tokens obtained through Plaid Link. OAuth client_credentials via /oauth/token is only documented for the Dashboard MCP. That is narrow, so it is not primary.
access_notes: Sandbox is free for all developers. US/CA developers who sign up on or after April 15, 2026 get an auto-approved free Trial plan with real data, capped at 10 Production Items. Full production needs approval.
blocker_notes: Sandbox is free and unlimited, and the Trial plan gives free real-data access to US/CA developers. Full production needs a few days of approval, but that does not block building a toolkit.

evidence.quote: These models only apply to Production traffic; usage of Sandbox is always free.
The Plaid Trial plan provides free access to Plaid's production APIs. You can connect real financial accounts, call production endpoints, and build projects
you must first create an OAuth token with the scope `mcp:dashboard` and the `client_credentials` grant type via the [`/oauth/token`](/docs/api/oauth/#oauthtoken) API.
The **Dashboard MCP server** is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid. It provides Production diagnostics and analytics tools
Most products can be immediately tested in Sandbox with no extra configuration.
